Bristol

Our widest course list: Category C, Category C+E, Driver CPC, ADR and Operator CPC.

This base

Our Bristol base brings practical licence training and classroom courses together. You can take Category C and Category C+E in the vehicle, and attend Driver CPC, ADR and Operator CPC in the classroom.

Getting here

Getting there

We send directions to the Bristol site when your course is confirmed, including the best approach if you are arriving by car.

Parking

Learner car parking is available at the Bristol base. We confirm where to park when you book.

Directions

The site address, a map and joining instructions are sent with your course confirmation.

Courses at Bristol

The courses we run at Bristol.

  • Rigid lorries

    Category C

    Practical training for rigid goods vehicles over 3.5 tonnes, for drivers moving up from a car licence.

    Offered at Bristol, Taunton and Exeter

    Enquire about this course

  • Articulated and drawbar

    Category C+E

    Trailer training for drivers who already hold Category C and need the articulated or drawbar entitlement.

    Offered at Bristol and Exeter

    Enquire about this course

  • Professional drivers

    Driver CPC

    Periodic training for professional drivers who need hours towards a Driver Qualification Card.

    Offered at Bristol and Taunton

    Enquire about this course

  • Sample course · Dangerous goods

    ADR

    Training for drivers who carry dangerous goods by road.

    Offered at Bristol

    Enquire about this course

  • Sample course · Transport managers

    Operator CPC

    Preparation for people working towards the transport-manager qualification.

    Offered at Bristol and Taunton

    Enquire about this course

Facilities and vehicles

  • Vehicle

    Rigid goods vehicle

    The training vehicle for Category C, used for yard exercises and road driving.

  • Vehicle

    Articulated combination

    Tractor unit and trailer for Category C+E, used for coupling, uncoupling, reversing and road driving.

  • Facility

    Training yard

    Off-road space for vehicle familiarisation, reversing and manoeuvres, so the basics are secure before time on the road.

  • Facility

    Classroom

    A classroom for Driver CPC, ADR and Operator CPC sessions.

  • Facility

    Parking

    Learner car parking at the base. We confirm where to park when your course is agreed.

Instructors

The teams who deliver training at this base.

  • Driving instructors

    Instructor team

    Driving instructors

    Our driving instructors take learners through Category C and Category C+E training: getting to know the vehicle, yard manoeuvres, coupling and uncoupling, and road driving. They also explain what the practical test involves.

    Category C and Category C+E

    Bristol, Taunton and Exeter

  • Classroom instructors

    Instructor team

    Classroom instructors

    Our classroom instructors run the Driver CPC, ADR and Operator CPC courses. They explain what each course covers, who it is for, and how it differs from the licence routes.

    Driver CPC, ADR and Operator CPC

    Bristol and Taunton

Local knowledge

Road driving from Bristol reflects the area around the base, with city traffic, main roads and the routes a working driver uses to move goods in and out of the city.

Learner feedback

What learners say about training at Bristol.

  • This learner already held Category C and wanted the trailer entitlement. Coupling and uncoupling were practised in the yard first, followed by reversing and road driving with the combination.

Category C, Category C+E, Driver CPC, ADR and Operator CPC.
